unresolved_issues.details: Table 1 and Table 2 subgroup counts differ: Uganda men 2177 vs 2179; Uganda women 2424 vs 2429; Malawi rural women 5894 vs 5893; Malawi urban women 7192 vs 7190. EXTEND women also differs 4641 vs 4183 outside this candidate. Table 1 subgroup n does not prove each variable-specific n.
unresolved_issues.resolution: Preserve table-specific counts and scope; do not harmonize, infer missingness causes or inverse-variance weights.

unresolved_issues.details: Table 2 reports HDL geometric mean 1.15 with 95% CI 1.15 to 1.26; printed values retained.
unresolved_issues.resolution: Point estimate remains a candidate; interval not used for weighting, SD conversion or an acceptance band.

unresolved_issues.details: Several printed CI endpoints coincide after rounding.
unresolved_issues.resolution: No zero-variance interpretation, CI-width-derived SD, exact equality tolerance or precision weight is authorized.
Age median/Q1/Q3 retained as reported distributional context, not executable calibration.
All Table 3 coefficients stay outside numerical candidates; no raw/log conversion, orientation reversal or insertion into a joint generator.
Do not drop smoking/alcohol to imitate the reported adjusted operators.
Equal-weight mathematical recipes are explicit operational choices, not a claim of verified source weighting.
External source strata are not interchangeable with Turkana lifestyle categories. Source health exclusions and assays cannot be recreated from target fields by assertion.

current_review: Original maintext Analysis reread through published PDF and Europe PMC XML on 2026-11-05; its generic log-transformation statement still does not map response/predictor transformations to each Table 3 row. Publisher DC2 indexed table text inspected; live publisher opens returned 403. No scale resolution or new raw-scale conversion is asserted.

implementation_disposition.geometric_mean: Unsupported by core source_checks. Requires a separately reviewed descriptive operator; do not relabel as mean.
implementation_disposition.threshold_proportion: Core proportion available; source weighting and reconstructed context remain explicit assumptions.
implementation_disposition.age_quantiles: Context only unless quantile-convention assumption declared.
implementation_disposition.regressions: Context only; scale unresolved, age+smoking/alcohol differs from available fields.
implementation_disposition.non_hdl_geometric_mean: Derived TC-HDL must be positive; no current core derived-column operator. No subtraction of geometric means.

regression_common_context.population: Pooled sub-Saharan African source cohorts under declared selection
